newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stocks shrug off strike to hit new high.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stocks shrug off strike to hit new high.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key industrial share index rose 8.08 points to a record 5,706.01, boosted again by foreign buyers and shrugging off a week-long strike for higher wages by local civil servants.
"The foreign investors are still in the driving seat and the strike still has no effect even on the local players," one broker said.
Tuesday's industrial index gain was mainly due to a 200 cents rise in tobacco processing group Rothmans at 2,400 and a 20-cent climb by banking group Finhold at 650.
The secondary seven-share mining index eased 1.61 points to 1,271.44 following five- and 12-cent drops in coal miners Wankie at 305 and gold producer Falgold at 165.
